Introduction

HyunA is a South Korean singer and rapper under AT AREA. She debuted in 2007 with Wonder Girls but left due to health issues. She re-debuted in 2009 with 4minute and launched a solo career in 2010. She gained international attention after appearing in PSY’s "Gangnam Style" and collaborating on the female version, "Oppa Is Just My Style."

HyunA has been part of various music units including Trouble Maker, Triple H, and HyunA&DAWN. In 2018, she confirmed her relationship with Dawn, leading to both being dropped from Cube Entertainment. They later joined PSY’s label, P Nation, in 2019. That same year, HyunA revealed she had been diagnosed with depression, panic disorder, and vasovagal syncope. She and Dawn got engaged in early 2022 but broke up later that year.
